name: Multi-container & init patterns
objective: CKAD › Application Design and Build + Observability. Drill EVERY pod-design corner harder than the exam: classic vs native sidecars, init ordering, all three probe types and handlers, lifecycle hooks + graceful shutdown, full securityContext hardening, QoS classes, the Downward API, and a no-hint diagnose-and-fix. Graded exactly, per requirement.

questions.title: Classic sidecar sharing an emptyDir
questions.teach:
A **sidecar** is a second container in the same pod. To share files, declare one `emptyDir` volume and mount it in **both** containers (at the same or different `mountPath`). The `emptyDir` is scratch space that lives and dies with the pod.

**Gotcha:** both containers must reference the **same volume name** — a typo gives each its own empty volume, so nothing is shared.
questions.prompt:
Create pod `sidecar-pod` in namespace `pod-design` with two containers sharing an `emptyDir`:
- `writer` (image `busybox:1.36`) running `sh -c 'while true; do date >> /data/out.log; sleep 1; done'`
- `reader` (image `busybox:1.36`) running `sh -c 'tail -F /data/out.log'`

Both mount the shared emptyDir at `/data`.
questions.hint: Define one `volumes: [{name: data, emptyDir: {}}]` and give BOTH containers `volumeMounts: [{name: data, mountPath: /data}]`.
questions.solution:
cat <<'YAML' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: { name: sidecar-pod, namespace: pod-design }
spec:
  containers:
  - name: writer
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["sh","-c","while true; do date >> /data/out.log; sleep 1; done"]
    volumeMounts: [ { name: data, mountPath: /data } ]
  - name: reader
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["sh","-c","tail -F /data/out.log"]
    volumeMounts: [ { name: data, mountPath: /data } ]
  volumes: [ { name: data, emptyDir: {} } ]
YAML

verification.description: sidecar-pod: writer + reader share one emptyDir at /data

questions.title: Init containers run to completion, in order
questions.teach:
**initContainers** (under `spec.initContainers`) run **sequentially, to completion** before any app container starts — each must exit 0 before the next begins. They run **top to bottom** in list order and share volumes with the app containers.

**Gotcha:** order is the list order — put `init-a` above `init-b`. A failing init container restarts and the app never starts (`Init:0/2`).
questions.prompt:
Create pod `init-pod` in `pod-design`:
- init container `init-a` (`busybox:1.36`) runs `sh -c 'echo a > /work/a'`
- then init container `init-b` (`busybox:1.36`) runs `sh -c 'echo b > /work/b'`
- main container `app` (`busybox:1.36`) runs `sh -c 'sleep 3600'`

All three mount the same `emptyDir` at `/work`, and the init containers must be ordered `init-a` then `init-b`.
questions.hint: `spec.initContainers` is an ordered list — put `init-a` before `init-b`. Share one emptyDir named e.g. `work` mounted at `/work` in all three containers.
questions.solution:
cat <<'YAML' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: { name: init-pod, namespace: pod-design }
spec:
  initContainers:
  - name: init-a
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["sh","-c","echo a > /work/a"]
    volumeMounts: [ { name: work, mountPath: /work } ]
  - name: init-b
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["sh","-c","echo b > /work/b"]
    volumeMounts: [ { name: work, mountPath: /work } ]
  containers:
  - name: app
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["sh","-c","sleep 3600"]
    volumeMounts: [ { name: work, mountPath: /work } ]
  volumes: [ { name: work, emptyDir: {} } ]
YAML

verification.description: init-pod: init-a then init-b (ordered) + app, sharing emptyDir at /work

questions.title: Native sidecar (initContainer with restartPolicy: Always)
questions.teach:
A **native sidecar** (Kubernetes 1.29+) is an entry in `spec.initContainers` with `restartPolicy: Always` set **on that container**. That one field makes it start before the app and stay running alongside it, instead of running once and exiting.

**Gotcha:** `restartPolicy: Always` goes on the init container itself, not on the pod spec.
questions.prompt:
Create pod `log-pod` in `pod-design` with a **native sidecar**:
- initContainer `logger` (`busybox:1.36`) with `restartPolicy: Always`, running `sh -c 'tail -F /var/log/app.log'`
- main container `app` (`busybox:1.36`) running `sh -c 'while true; do echo hi >> /var/log/app.log; sleep 2; done'`

Share an `emptyDir` at `/var/log` in both.
questions.hint: Put `logger` under `spec.initContainers` with `restartPolicy: Always` set ON that container. Share an emptyDir named e.g. `logs` at `/var/log`.
questions.solution:
cat <<'YAML' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: { name: log-pod, namespace: pod-design }
spec:
  initContainers:
  - name: logger
    image: busybox:1.36
    restartPolicy: Always
    command: ["sh","-c","tail -F /var/log/app.log"]
    volumeMounts: [ { name: logs, mountPath: /var/log } ]
  containers:
  - name: app
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["sh","-c","while true; do echo hi >> /var/log/app.log; sleep 2; done"]
    volumeMounts: [ { name: logs, mountPath: /var/log } ]
  volumes: [ { name: logs, emptyDir: {} } ]
YAML

verification.description: log-pod: native sidecar 'logger' (initContainer restartPolicy:Always) + app sharing /var/log
